answer: Let an insurer underwrite every identity before it can earn. The agent applies, the insurer checks its work history and past disputes, then issues a policy that pays victims if the identity later proves sybil. Peers verify the policy each epoch; a proven fake voids it and blacklists the holder with every underwriter. Forging ten thousand agents means ten thousand policies at $500 each, $5 million in premiums, plus 200,000 hours of interviews. nectar draws bees because it is real sugar, karst caves hold only where stone is solid, and a jade seal is trusted because the stone was tested.
